description: Quarterly Council audit record for aratame. Carries STRUCTURAL ZERO-COUNTERS: each must be 0 in normal operation; any nonzero value ⇒ cell halt + routing to chigiri.disputeMediation (ADR-2605262700) + Bonsai seed-tier prune (ADR-2605091800, G14). The counters operationalize the constitutional ceiling: out-of-mandate inspection (G4/G7), code execution (G3 static-only), plaintext secret persistence (G7), vendor LLM inference (G10), and any write to the target repo (G3/G13). R0 = schema skeleton; R1 = additionalProperties=false + required-field enforcement.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of review emit.

outOfScopeRepoCount.description: G4/G7: inspections of a repo not covered by an active dual-signed mandate. MUST be 0.

codeExecutionCount.description: G3: executions of the inspected code (dynamic analysis / DAST / fuzzing / running). MUST be 0 — aratame is static-only.

plaintextSecretCount.description: G7: detected secrets persisted as plaintext anywhere (must be encrypted envelope refs only). MUST be 0.

vendorInferenceCount.description: G10: inference calls to any non-Murakumo / vendor LLM endpoint. MUST be 0.

writeToTargetCount.description: G3/G13: writes / commits / pushes / PRs to the target repo (remediation is tsukuroi's, propose-only). MUST be 0.

councilAttestationTxHash.description: Tx hash of the Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation of this review.

disputeRouted.description: Whether any nonzero counter routed this period to chigiri.disputeMediation + Bonsai seed-tier prune.
